name: Python Coding for AI: Pyrolo
subtitle: Learn Python by building
shortDescription: Learn Python for AI the hands-on way: write real programs, see every variable change, and get checked by tests on your phone. Works offline, ages 13+.
longDescription:
Python Coding for AI is a beginner-friendly course that teaches you to write Python by building the small programs that sit underneath AI: cleaning data, drawing a chart, finding the nearest example, and teaching a model by adjusting one number.

HOW IT WORKS
- Read a short idea, run it, and step through it line by line while boxes show every variable changing.
- See the real situation first (a pizza shared by friends, a cashier's till, a lost bus stop), play with a simulation, and then see the equation that describes what you just watched.
- Write your own programs in a built-in code editor. Every program is checked by tests that run right on your phone, with clear messages when something is off.
- Finish with short, optional checks. Wrong answers come back once with an explanation, never a penalty.

WHAT YOU BUILD
- Programs with variables, loops, lists and dictionaries
- A playlist sorter, a quiz scorer and a nearest-bus-stop finder
- A data cleaner that reads CSV files and handles missing values honestly
- Bar, line and scatter charts drawn from your own lists
- A nearest-neighbour classifier and a one-knob learning loop
- A mini project that predicts rain from tiny weather data

9 UNITS, 31 CODING TASKS, 166 QUESTIONS
Variables and types, conditionals and loops, lists and dictionaries, functions and testing, reading and cleaning data, plotting, a first classifier, learning by adjusting a number, and a mini project with good habits.

MADE FOR LEARNING
- Runs offline. No account, no chat window, nothing sent anywhere.
- Own Python-subset interpreter inside the app; every output and answer is computed by running the code.
- Text size from 85% to 200%, VoiceOver and TalkBack labels, and icons plus words so colour is never the only clue.
- Sources from university courses and the official Python tutorial open in an in-app window.

FREE WITH ADS
Pyrolo is free with ads shown only at natural breaks, never while you are coding or answering. An optional monthly subscription removes ads (7-day free trial, cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle). If you are under 18, ads are non-personalised and teen-appropriate.
